description: This skill should be used when an agent needs the owner's answer through hoptell, when the user asks to "ask me on Telegram", "ping me when it's done", "notify the owner", "send me a note", or when choosing between the ask_owner tool and a plain send_message note to the owner channel bridge. It covers what to send, limits, secrets and how to treat answers.
